from pyspark.sql.types import *
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from datetime import datetime, date
import time
import json
import sys

# Standard ODW monitoring variables
start_exec_time = datetime.now()
insert_count = 0
update_count = 0
delete_count = 0
error_message = ''

# Database and Table names
harmonised_db = "odw_harmonised_db"
curated_db = "odw_curated_db"

source_table = f"{harmonised_db}.nsip_project"
spark_table_final = f"{curated_db}.nsip_project_measures"
table_name = "nsip_project_measures"

container_name = "odw-curated"
table_folder = "nsip_project_measures"

try:
    # Resolve storage account dynamically across Dev / Test / Prod
    storage_account = mssparkutils.notebook.run('/utils/py_utils_get_storage_account')
    storage_account = storage_account.strip().replace("/", "")

    # Construct standard external table storage path
    target_path = f"abfss://{container_name}@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/{table_folder}"

    print(f"Source Table:  {source_table}")
    print(f"Target Table:  {spark_table_final}")
    print(f"External Path: {target_path}")

except Exception as e:
    error_message = f"Error resolving storage path: {str(e)[:800]}"
    print(error_message)

if not error_message:
    try:
        # Filter for active records only (IsActive = 'Y') and enforce 1:1 primary key grain
        df_harmonised_raw = (
            spark.table(source_table)
            .filter(F.col("IsActive") == "Y")
            .filter(F.col("caseReference").isNotNull())
        )
        
        # Deduplicate on caseReference to guarantee unique 1:1 grain
        df_active_projects = df_harmonised_raw.dropDuplicates(["caseReference"])
        
        source_count = df_active_projects.count()
        print(f"Loaded active unique NSIP projects: {source_count}")

    except Exception as e:
        error_message = f"Error reading from {source_table}: {str(e)[:800]}"
        print(error_message)

if not error_message:
    try:
        # Divisors per AC4
        YEAR_DIVISOR = 365.2425
        MONTH_DIVISOR = 30.436875

        # Check for Withdrawn status using the actual column 'stage' (case-insensitive)
        is_not_withdrawn = (
            F.col("stage").isNotNull() & 
            (F.lower(F.col("stage")) != "withdrawn")
        )

        # --- 1. Pre-App Stage ---
        preapp_valid = (
            is_not_withdrawn 
            & F.col("inceptionMeetingDate").isNotNull() 
            & F.col("dateOfDCOSubmission").isNotNull()
        )
        preAppCompleted = F.when(preapp_valid, 1).otherwise(0)
        preAppDurationYears = F.when(
            preapp_valid,
            (F.datediff(F.to_date("dateOfDCOSubmission"), F.to_date("inceptionMeetingDate")) / YEAR_DIVISOR).cast("decimal(18,4)")
        ).otherwise(None)
        datePreAppCompleted = F.when(preapp_valid, F.to_date("dateOfDCOSubmission")).otherwise(None)

        # --- 2. Acceptance Stage ---
        acceptance_valid = (
            is_not_withdrawn 
            & F.col("dateOfDCOSubmission").isNotNull() 
            & F.col("dateOfDCOAcceptance").isNotNull()
        )
        acceptanceCompleted = F.when(acceptance_valid, 1).otherwise(0)
        acceptanceDurationDays = F.when(
            acceptance_valid,
            F.datediff(F.to_date("dateOfDCOAcceptance"), F.to_date("dateOfDCOSubmission")).cast("decimal(18,4)")
        ).otherwise(None)
        dateAcceptanceCompleted = F.when(acceptance_valid, F.to_date("dateOfDCOAcceptance")).otherwise(None)

        # --- 3. Pre-Examination Stage ---
        preexam_valid = (
            is_not_withdrawn 
            & F.col("dateOfDCOAcceptance").isNotNull() 
            & F.col("confirmedStartOfExamination").isNotNull()
        )
        preExaminationCompleted = F.when(preexam_valid, 1).otherwise(0)
        preExaminationDurationMonths = F.when(
            preexam_valid,
            (F.datediff(F.to_date("confirmedStartOfExamination"), F.to_date("dateOfDCOAcceptance")) / MONTH_DIVISOR).cast("decimal(18,4)")
        ).otherwise(None)
        datePreExaminationCompleted = F.when(preexam_valid, F.to_date("confirmedStartOfExamination")).otherwise(None)

        # --- 4. Examination Stage (dateTimeExaminationEnds cast to DATE per AC3) ---
        exam_valid = (
            is_not_withdrawn 
            & F.col("confirmedStartOfExamination").isNotNull() 
            & F.col("dateTimeExaminationEnds").isNotNull()
        )
        examinationCompleted = F.when(exam_valid, 1).otherwise(0)
        examinationDurationMonths = F.when(
            exam_valid,
            (F.datediff(F.to_date("dateTimeExaminationEnds"), F.to_date("confirmedStartOfExamination")) / MONTH_DIVISOR).cast("decimal(18,4)")
        ).otherwise(None)
        dateExaminationCompleted = F.when(exam_valid, F.to_date("dateTimeExaminationEnds")).otherwise(None)

        # --- 5. Recommendation Stage ---
        rec_valid = (
            is_not_withdrawn 
            & F.col("dateTimeExaminationEnds").isNotNull() 
            & F.col("dateOfRecommendations").isNotNull()
        )
        recommendationCompleted = F.when(rec_valid, 1).otherwise(0)
        recommendationDurationMonths = F.when(
            rec_valid,
            (F.datediff(F.to_date("dateOfRecommendations"), F.to_date("dateTimeExaminationEnds")) / MONTH_DIVISOR).cast("decimal(18,4)")
        ).otherwise(None)
        dateRecommendationCompleted = F.when(rec_valid, F.to_date("dateOfRecommendations")).otherwise(None)

        # Assemble Curated DataFrame
        df_curated = df_active_projects.select(
            F.col("caseReference"),
            preAppDurationYears.alias("preAppDurationYears"),
            preAppCompleted.alias("preAppCompleted"),
            datePreAppCompleted.alias("datePreAppCompleted"),
            acceptanceDurationDays.alias("acceptanceDurationDays"),
            acceptanceCompleted.alias("acceptanceCompleted"),
            dateAcceptanceCompleted.alias("dateAcceptanceCompleted"),
            preExaminationDurationMonths.alias("preExaminationDurationMonths"),
            preExaminationCompleted.alias("preExaminationCompleted"),
            datePreExaminationCompleted.alias("datePreExaminationCompleted"),
            examinationDurationMonths.alias("examinationDurationMonths"),
            examinationCompleted.alias("examinationCompleted"),
            dateExaminationCompleted.alias("dateExaminationCompleted"),
            recommendationDurationMonths.alias("recommendationDurationMonths"),
            recommendationCompleted.alias("recommendationCompleted"),
            dateRecommendationCompleted.alias("dateRecommendationCompleted"),
            F.current_timestamp().alias("odwCuratedIngestionDate")
        )

        print(f"Calculations complete. Row count ready to persist: {df_curated.count()}")

    except Exception as e:
        error_message = f"Error during stage metric calculation: {str(e)[:800]}"
        print(error_message)

if not error_message:
    try:
        insert_count = df_curated.count()

        # Write in Parquet format using overwrite mode
        (
            df_curated.write
            .mode("overwrite")
            .format("parquet")
            .saveAsTable(spark_table_final)
        )

        print(f"Successfully populated {spark_table_final} (format: parquet) with {insert_count} records.")

    except Exception as e:
        error_message = f"Error writing table {spark_table_final}: {str(e)[:800]}"
        print(error_message)

end_exec_time = datetime.now()
duration_seconds = (end_exec_time - start_exec_time).total_seconds()
activity_type = f"{mssparkutils.runtime.context.get('currentNotebookName', 'py_curated_nsip_project_measures')} Notebook"
stage = "Success" if not error_message else "Failed"
status_message = (
    f"Successfully loaded data into {spark_table_final} table"
    if not error_message
    else f"Failed to load data into {spark_table_final} table: {error_message}"
)
status_code = "200" if stage == "Success" else "500"

# Dispatch standard telemetry
log_telemetry_and_exit(
    stage,
    start_exec_time,
    end_exec_time,
    error_message,
    table_name,
    insert_count,
    update_count,
    delete_count,
    PipelineName,
    PipelineRunID,
    PipelineTriggerID,
    PipelineTriggerName,
    PipelineTriggerType,
    PipelineTriggeredbyPipelineName,
    PipelineTriggeredbyPipelineRunID,
    activity_type,
    duration_seconds,
    status_message,
    status_code
